debug.description: Enables global debug mode to print additional diagnostic information.

verbose.description: Enables verbose output, showing more details during execution.

caBundle.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate bundle used to verify server certificates. When omitted, the system trust store is used.

baseRequest.description: YAML-only shared request template. Define an anchor (e.g. baseRequest: &base) and merge into requests with <<: *base. Ignored by https-wrench at runtime.

requests.description: List of HTTPS requests to execute.

RequestDefaults.description: Shared request fields with no required keys. Used by baseRequest anchors and merged into requests[] entries.

name.description: Descriptive name for this request, used in output. Required on each requests[] entry.

transportOverrideUrl.description: TLS/TCP dial address (https://host or https://ip:port). The logical hostname remains hosts[].name for Host header and SNI.

requestDebug.description: If true, dumps the raw outgoing HTTP request for debugging.

responseDebug.description: If true, dumps the raw HTTP response, including TLS connection details, for debugging.

responseBodyMatchRegexp.description: Regular expression that the response body must match.

printResponseBody.description: If true, prints the HTTP response body.

printResponseHeaders.description: If true, prints HTTP response headers.

printResponseCertificates.description: If true, prints TLS certificates from the peer chain.

responseCertificatesFilter.description: Filter to display only specific certificates from the peer chain and/or only subset of fields for each certificate. Each item in the array is a map of certificate index (0-indexed, where 0 is the leaf certificate) to a list of certificate fields to render (e.g. Subject, DNSNames, Issuer, NotBefore, NotAfter, Expiration). If the list of fields is empty, all fields for that certificate are printed.

items.description: Map of certificate chain index to the list of certificate fields to print.

^[0-9]+$.description: Certificate fields to print for the given chain index.

items.description: Certificate field name to include in output.

enableProxyProtocolV2.description: If true, sends an HAProxy PROXY protocol v2 header on connect. Requires transportOverrideUrl.

insecure.description: If true, skips TLS server certificate verification (InsecureSkipVerify).

responseHeadersFilter.description: Response header names to include when printResponseHeaders is enabled.

items.description: HTTP response header name. Must start with an uppercase letter.

requestMethod.description: HTTP method for the request. Defaults to GET when omitted.

requestHeaders.description: Custom HTTP request headers to send.

userAgent.description: Custom User-Agent string for the request.

hosts.description: Target hostnames and paths to request. Required on each requests[] entry.

RequestDefaults.title: RequestDefaults

Request.description: A single HTTPS probe definition. Each entry must include name and hosts.
Request.title: Request

Host.description: A logical hostname and the URI paths to request on it.

name.description: Hostname used for the request URL, Host header, and TLS ServerName indication.

uriList.description: URI paths to request on this host. Each path must start with /. When omitted, tool defaults apply.

Host.title: Host

RequestHeader.description: A single HTTP request header key-value pair.
RequestHeader.title: RequestHeader
